entities.summary: Dianne Evers is a retired female tennis player from Australia. With her partner Judy Chaloner, she won the 1979 Australian Open Doubles title and had a career high singles ranking of No. 42. Dianne Evers was a athletes & competitors from Melbourne (b. 1956-11-09, Melbourne). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
